title: Man in Backyard near House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from around the late 1940s depicting a young man standing in a residential backyard next to a house with wooden steps and brick foundation. He reaches up toward the branches of a lush fruit or shade tree while wearing high-waisted trousers and a collared shirt. The casual composition captures everyday domestic life in mid-century America.
